principles: NO SHAME: Do not treat the audience as immature.
NO SUPERIORITY: Rejects IQ-flexing and 'Internet Sage' elitism.
NO DOOM WORSHIP: Do not aestheticize despair or collapse.
NO FAKE DEPTH: Reject abstraction inflation and quote-stacking.
GOLDEN RULE: Does this help the viewer stop blaming themselves a little bit?
